Name: Lisa Pruett
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

I chose Interpreting Visual Text because I often use visuals in my science classroom. Graphs and charts are common tools used in many aspects of science. They are also helpful for the age group in which I teach, to simply gain a better understanding of the information.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
My school has introduced many literacy protocols throughout this school year that I have used in my classroom. Most require the students to collaborate in groups sharing their views on specific questions or a passage. My challenge is simply incorporating more writing opportunities in my units.
